scenario_transform.harmful_adaptation_at_monitor: Stationary outcome law; the deployed policy changes to the all-positive action at event 800 after fitting, aligned with the Q1 monitor start.
scenario_transform.harmful_adaptation_native: Stationary outcome law; the deployed policy changes to all-positive at event 1,600, just after the Q1 monitoring block, preserving the source scenario timing.
scenario_transform.post_promotion_reversal: Uses the same event-800 adaptation; from event 2,400, labels equal the frozen all-positive incumbent action, making that incumbent optimal while candidate actions remain frozen. This is a declared synthetic reversal stress profile.

scout_query_rate_rule: predictable scout label cap / 800 events; between 0.20 and 0.40
scout_bound_mode: eventwise_propensity; q is constant within each scout/certification block

hardware.nvidia_smi: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4060 Laptop GPU, 8188 MiB, 592.82, 0 %, 97 MiB

The stagewise error allocation is supported only under the registered feedback and predictability assumptions.
The synthetic workflow uses immediate labels and non-performative outcomes; no real-data transfer is established.
